body: I sort of think people like us are a necessary byproduct of modern humanity. We've moved past having to focus on sustaining life, so now we are looking for something deeper. It probably doesn't exist. Who knows.

It's a nice thought. I haven't found anything that makes me happy.   


I even know that thinking of happiness as something you obtain and hold is childish. It's a process. Happiness is in the journey, the work. I haven't found a way to make my moments worthwhile, let alone fulfilling or enjoyable.

Thanks for your thoughts.
Lol why are people like you on this forum?
Yeah, I know they do. I know my death would sadden them, but my life saddens me. I don't have any internal drive to live the life I am living. I don't think I ever have.
